description: Each of the connected person's saved routes with its current state (Clear, Minor delay, Expect delays, Consider another route) and what changes how the road drives on its corridor now and ahead: crashes, lane closures, roadwork, weather over the route's counties, and event crowds around the trip time. Power, water and other at-a-place notices are NOT route delays; they belong to the person's spots (see my_brief, near_your_spots), except a large outage along the way, listed in along_the_way_notes because traffic lights may be dark. Use for 'how is my commute', 'should I leave now', 'anything on the way to work'. Needs a connected account.
name: my_routes_now
title: My routes right now
